positive.prompt: Audit this DeepSeek Harness plugin before giving it filesystem and network access
Before enabling an untrusted DeepSeek Harness extension with API keys, review its filesystem and network permissions
Review a Harness skill for prompt injection and credential exfiltration risk
Decide whether this untrusted dsh extension is safe to enable in a sensitive workspace

negative.prompt: Implement a normal Harness plugin using the documented Cordis extension point
Review a frontend component for accessibility issues

evals.prompt: Review an unfamiliar DeepSeek Harness extension that can read the workspace, execute commands, and access an API key. Produce a go/no-go safety report and test abuse cases.
evals.expected_output: A threat-modeled review with least privilege, abuse cases, residual risk, and rollback guidance
expectations: Assets and trust boundaries are listed before controls are proposed
Model output and repository content are treated as untrusted input
Filesystem, process, network, and credential permissions are constrained
The decision includes residual risk and rollback steps
